$comment: Illustrative MCP server manifest for thehosksaid.com. Adapt to the discovery format your runtime expects; the canonical contract is the live MCP handshake at the endpoint below.
name: thehosksaid
description: Retrieval over an independent, AI-generated transcript index of Charles Hoskinson's public videos (talks, AMAs, whiteboards). Synthesized, citation-backed answers grounded in timestamped transcript segments.

authentication.note: Anonymous access is read-only and rate-limited (60 req/min/IP). Send 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' for 600 req/min.

tools.name: search_archive
tools.description: Synthesized, citation-backed answer to a natural-language question. The flagship retrieval tool.

tools.name: search_segments
tools.description: Raw semantic search over every transcript segment, ranked by relevance.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Full metadata, chapters and topics for a single indexed video.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: The complete transcript of a video as segments, plain text, or WebVTT.

tools.name: get_segment
tools.description: A single timestamped segment with its neighbours and a deep link to the moment.

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: Paginated catalogue of all indexed videos.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Every clustered topic with citation, video and segment counts.
